mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential recessionary slowdown in corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to benefit from a robust economy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate hiring freezes and revenue concerns mount.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as elevated borrowing costs suppress corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to lower earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
